cd /workspace/tmp && python3 -c "
import sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from compiler import participant_distance, Router, _adjacency
from collections import defaultdict
m=16
links=[(i,(i+1)%m) for i in range(m)]
parts=[(i,1) for i in range(m)]
caps=[8]*m
n=m
dist=participant_distance(n,links,parts,caps)
names=[p[0] for p in parts]
router=Router(n,links,caps)
# emulate _deliver for v=13 with diagnostics
v=13; rv=1
have={w:0 for w in names}; have[v]=rv
order=sorted([w for w in names if w!=v], key=lambda w:(dist[(v,w)],w))
print('order', order)
partset=set(names)
senders_all=[v]+[w for w in names if w!=v]
for _p in range(8):
    for w in order:
        need=rv-have[w]
        if need<=0: continue
        cands=[u for u in senders_all if have.get(u,0)>0 and u!=w]
        cands.sort(key=lambda u:(dist.get((u,w),99),u))
        got_total=0
        for u in cands:
            need=rv-have[w]
            if need<=0: break
            cap=min(have[u],need)
            if dist.get((u,w),99)==99: continue
            allowed=set(range(n))-(partset-set([u,w]))
            fl=router.route_max(u,w,cap,allowed)
            if fl is None: continue
            got=sum(c for _,c in fl)
            if got: have[w]+=got; got_total+=got
        if have[w]<rv:
            print('pass',_p,'w',w,'short',rv-have[w],'tried',[ (u,dist.get((u,w),99)) for u in cands][:3])
    if all(have[w]>=rv for w in names): break
print('have ok', all(have[w]>=rv for w in names))
print('res', router.res)
"
